text: LBM lid-driven cavity at Re100 Advance a four-wall Re100 LBM flow and compare Ghia centerlines and the primary vortex, recording wall momentum exchange. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. LBM Re100 cavity: actual2D fields and Ghia centerlines Advance genuine four-wall BGK flow on three fixed grids, checking nominal-lid Ghia centerlines, primary vortex, stationarity and wall momentum budgets. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Physical unit square, lid1, viscosity.01, Re100; N24/32/48, lattice lid.04, dt=.04/N. Three stationary walls/rightward lid; stationary side owns a simultaneous top/side link. Initialrho1/rest. Editorial clarification Three finite-Mach educational grids. Ghia is a rounded independent numerical reference, not exact. No pointwise corner order/high-Re claim or borrowed success from another cavity solver. A standard C++17compiler is required. Adopted numerical method Standard D2Q9equilibrium/BGK collision, nonperiodic link streaming and moving halfway reflection atq=.5.
